entries.jp:
数日後
二条城の天守閣には
重苦しいため息が
響いていた
entries.en:
A few days later,
heavy sighs
echoed through
the keep of Nijo
Castle.

entries.jp: 慶喜様　いかがなさいました\n具合でも悪いのですか
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama,
what is the
matter? Are you
feeling unwell?

entries.jp: 身体の調子は問題ない\n気分が良くないだけ
entries.en: My body is\nfine. I just\ndon't feel good.

entries.jp: 今日の昼　直弼も家臣から\n報告を受けたよね
entries.en:
Naosuke, you
received the
report from
the retainers
at noon today
too, didn't you?

entries.jp: 坂本龍馬と\nその仲間達の傍若無人な\n振る舞いについて……
entries.en:
About the
outrageous
behavior of
Ryoma Sakamoto
and his friends...

entries.jp: ええ　存じていますよ\n奴らが突風雷舞を繰り返し　\n民衆を惑わせている事は
entries.en:
Yes, I'm well
aware. They keep
staging guerrilla
lives and leading
the people astray.

entries.jp: 坂本達の贔屓は\n日に日に増えている\nそうだね
entries.en: Their fans are\ngrowing by the\nday, aren't they?

entries.jp: このまま奴らのロックが\n民の間で流行り病のように\n広まったりしないかな
entries.en:
I wonder if their
rock won't spread
among the people
like an epidemic.

entries.jp: 大丈夫です　慶喜様の\n天下が揺らぐなどあり得ない\n決して　絶対にです
entries.en:
Have no fear.
Your reign could
never waver,
Yoshinobu-sama.
Never. Not ever.

entries.jp: そうかな
entries.en: You think so?

entries.jp: 噂によると　奴らは明日　\nイケダヤンで歌うらしいね
entries.en:
Rumor has it
they'll sing
at Ikedayan
tomorrow.

entries.jp: あの広い会場で歌う\nということは……
entries.en: If they're singing\nin a venue that\nlarge...

entries.jp: 奴らに　それなりの数の\n贔屓がついてる証拠だと\n思うけど？
entries.en:
...I'd call that
proof they have
a fair number
of fans,
wouldn't you?

entries.jp: 慶喜様は\nそのような事を\n考える必要はありません
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama,
you need not
trouble
yourself with
such matters.

entries.jp: でも　気になるよ
entries.en: But it bothers me.

entries.jp: ならば　慶喜様の\n御心痛を和らげるため
entries.en:
Then, to ease
your troubled
heart,
Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 明日　沖田をイケダヤンに\n差し向けましょう
entries.en: ...let us send\nOkita to Ikedayan\ntomorrow.

entries.jp: 噂話が真実だった場合\n反幕府の者達を新選組の\n歌で引き戻すのです
entries.en:
If the rumors
prove true, he
will win the
anti-shogunate
rabble back with
the Shinsengumi's
song.

entries.jp: 嵐山の逆となりましょうぞ\n慶喜様　いかがでしょう
entries.en:
It shall be
Arashiyama
in reverse.
Yoshinobu-sama,
what say you?

entries.jp: うん　それが良い\n直弼　頼んだよ\n期待してるからね
entries.en:
Yes, that's good.
Naosuke, I'm
counting on you. I
have high hopes.

entries.jp: 勿体ない御言葉　\n有り難く存じます
entries.en:
Such words
are more than
I deserve. I am
most grateful.

entries.jp: 私は慶喜様を一人になど\n断じてしませんよ\n例えどんな手を使っても
entries.en:
I will never
leave you alone,
Yoshinobu-sama.
Whatever means
I must use.

entries.jp:
慶喜を優しくなだめ
井伊は
龍馬達とは関係のない
他愛無い話を始める
entries.en:
Gently soothing
Yoshinobu, Ii
began some idle
chatter that
had nothing to
do with Ryoma
and his friends.

entries.jp: 蝋燭に照らし出された\n怜悧な顔には　\n冷たい微笑が浮かんでいた
entries.en:
On his shrewd
face, lit by
candlelight,
floated a cold
smile.

entries.jp:
……その頃
静まり返った
舞台（ステージ）の上を
龍馬は一人歩いていた
entries.en:
...Meanwhile,
Ryoma was
walking alone
across the
silent stage.

entries.jp: ここがイケダヤンの舞台か\n稽古の時に上がったが\nやっぱり広いなあ
entries.en:
So this is
Ikedayan's stage.
I was up here
for rehearsal,
but it sure is big.

entries.jp: 今は真夜中\nここには\nわししか居ない
entries.en:
It's the middle
of the night.
Ain't nobody
here but me.

entries.jp: だけど明日になれば\n数え切れないくらい\n大勢の人が来てくれる
entries.en:
But come
tomorrow,
more folks than
I can count are
gonna show up.

entries.jp: 今は何も聞こえないけど\n明日にはわしらのロックが\n聞こえる
entries.en:
Can't hear a
thing now, but
tomorrow, our
rock's gonna
ring out here.

entries.jp: わしらのロックに合わせて\nみんなが叫ぶ声が聞こえる
entries.en:
I'll hear
everybody
shoutin' along
to our rock.

entries.jp: くぅぅぅ　考えただけで\n熱くなってきたぜよ
entries.en:
Kuuuh, just
thinkin' about
it's got me all
heated up!

entries.jp: 身体中がジンジンして\n眠れないっ 早く明日に\nならないかなあ
entries.en:
My whole body's
tinglin'. I can't
sleep! Can't
tomorrow hurry
up and get here?

entries.jp: 龍馬は長いため息を吐き\n遠くを見つめる
entries.en:
Ryoma let out
a long sigh
and gazed into
the distance.

entries.jp: そんな中
entries.en: Just then...

entries.jp: 入口の扉がゆっくり開き\n長身の人影が入ってきた
entries.en:
...the entrance
door slowly
opened, and a tall
figure stepped in.

entries.jp: おお　シンディ\nおんしも来たのか
entries.en: Ooh, Shindy!\nYou came too?

entries.jp: ……龍馬？
entries.en: ...Ryoma?

entries.jp: 龍馬が舞台の上で手を振ると\n高杉は彼を睨みつけながら\n同じ場所に立った
entries.en:
When Ryoma
waved from the
stage, Takasugi
glared at him
and came to
stand beside him.

entries.jp: そこをどけ\n舞台のド真ん中は\nオレ様の場所だ
entries.en:
Move. Dead
center stage
belongs to
yours truly.

entries.jp: おっ　シンディ\n今から何か歌ってくれる\nのか？
entries.en:
Oh, Shindy,
you gonna
sing somethin'
for me now?

entries.jp: はっ　大一番の前日に\nバカ一人のためだけに\n歌うわけないだろ
entries.en:
Ha! As if I'd
sing for one
lousy idiot the
day before
the big show.

entries.jp: それならシンディは　\n何しに来たんだ？
entries.en: Then what'd\nyou come here\nfor, Shindy?

entries.jp: 明日の下見だ
entries.en: To scout the place\nfor tomorrow.

entries.jp: おお　という事は\nわしと同じか！
entries.en: Ooh, so you're\nhere for the same\nreason I am!

entries.jp: バカと一緒にするな\nお前はただ舞台の上に\n突っ立ってただけだろう
entries.en:
Don't lump me
in with an idiot.
All you did was
stand around
on the stage.

entries.jp: ほら　そこを退け
entries.en: Now, outta\nthe way.

entries.jp: 高杉は龍馬を押しのけると\n舞台の中央に色付きの\nテープを貼りはじめた
entries.en:
Takasugi shoved
Ryoma aside and
began sticking
colored tape to
the center of the
stage.

entries.jp: ほー　立ち位置に\n印をつけているのか\n流石シンディだなあ
entries.en:
Huh, markin'
where you
stand? That's
Shindy for ya!

entries.jp: ……あ　そう言えば\nシンディに話が\nあったぜよ
entries.en:
...Oh, that
reminds me. I
had somethin'
to talk to you
about, Shindy.

entries.jp: 明日の雷舞の曲順を\n決めておかなくちゃ\nならん
entries.en:
We gotta settle
the song order
for tomorrow's
live.

entries.jp: オレ様に聞くな\nそういうのは　全て\n桂さんに任せてある
entries.en:
Don't ask me.
I leave all
that stuff to
Katsura-san.

entries.jp: もう　センセーとも\n話し合ったんだ
entries.en: I already talked it\nover with Sensei.

entries.jp: 大体の曲順も\n決まってる
entries.en: We've got the\nrough order\nsettled, too.

entries.jp: そこで\n相談があるんだが――
entries.en: So, there's\nsomethin' I\nwanna ask ya--

entries.jp: 相談？\n言うだけ言ってみろ
entries.en: Ask me? Go on,\nsay it, at least.

entries.jp: わしが　一番手で\n歌いたいぜよ
entries.en: I wanna\nsing first!

entries.jp: いや　シンディが\n一番手を　譲りたくない\n気持ちも　よくわかる！
entries.en:
No, I know full
well you don't
wanna give up
the opening
spot, Shindy!

entries.jp: けど　この舞台を見たら\nもうガマンできん！
entries.en:
But one look at
this stage, and
I just can't hold
back anymore!

entries.jp: わしは　一秒でも早く\nみんなの前で\n歌いたいんだ！
entries.en:
I wanna sing
in front of
everybody,
even one
second sooner!

entries.jp: 頼む！　どうか\nわしに一番手を\n譲ってくれ！
entries.en: Please! I'm\nbeggin' ya, let\nme go first!

entries.jp: いいぜ
entries.en: Sure.

entries.jp: そうか\nやっぱり　ダメか……
entries.en: I see... So it's a\nno after all...

entries.jp: 話を聞け！\nお前が一番手でいいと\nオレ様は言ったんだ
entries.en: Listen, will you!\nYours truly said\nyou CAN go first.

entries.jp: へ？　いいのか\nわしが一番最初に\n歌っても　いいのか
entries.en: Huh? Really? I\nget to sing first?\nI really can?

entries.jp: しつこいな！\nいいと言ってるだろ！
entries.en: You're persistent!\nI said it's fine!

entries.jp: ありがとう　シンディ！\nお前さんは　本当に\nイイヤツだ
entries.en: Thanks, Shindy!\nYou're a real good\nguy, y'know that!

entries.jp: おいっ！　よせ！\n抱きつくんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Hey! Quit it!\nDon't hug me!

entries.jp: ただし　代わりに最後の\n曲は　オレ様に決めさせて\nもらうぞ
entries.en:
But in exchange,
the great
Takasugi gets to
pick the last song.

entries.jp: いいな？
entries.en: Got it?

entries.jp: 最後の曲？
entries.en: The last song?

entries.jp: ああ\nそうだ
entries.en: Yeah, that's right.

entries.jp: まず　龍馬の歌で\n会場を盛り上げる
entries.en: First, Ryoma's\nsong gets the\nvenue going.

entries.jp: 客が温まったところで\nトリをオレ様の新曲で\nクールに締める
entries.en:
Once the crowd's
warmed up, I'll
finish with my
brand-new song
as the closer.
Cool as ice.

entries.jp: 悪くねえ段取りだぜ
entries.en: Not a bad\nrunning order.

entries.jp: トリでシメる？\n舞台の上で　料理でも\n披露するのか？
entries.en:
The cooker?
You puttin' on
a cookin' show
up there?

entries.jp: そうじゃねえよ！
entries.en: That's not\nwhat I meant!

entries.jp: よくわからんが\nわしは　シンディの\n意見に賛成
entries.en:
Not sure I
follow, but I'm
with Shindy
on this one.

entries.jp: お前なあ……\nよくわからん　で\n決めちまっていいのかよ
entries.en:
You... Is "not sure
I follow" really
good enough to
decide on?

entries.jp: シンディの言うとおりに\nすれば雷舞が盛り上がると\n言うなら　それでよかろう？
entries.en:
Shindy, if doin'
it your way gets
the live fired
up, then that's
fine, ain't it?

entries.jp: わしは　シンディのことを\n信じているからな！
entries.en: 'Cause I believe\nin ya, Shindy!

entries.jp: ……どこまでも\nおめでたいヤロウだ
entries.en:
...You're a
hopeless
optimist, through
and through.

entries.jp: なあ　龍馬\nひとつだけ聞かせてくれ
entries.en: Hey, Ryoma. Tell\nme just one thing.

entries.jp: む？\nわしで良ければ\nいくらでも答えるぜよ
entries.en:
Hm? If I'm the
one you're askin',
ask away, I'll
answer anything!

entries.jp: どうして　そこまで\n他人を信じる事が\nできるんだ？
entries.en: How can you trust\nother people that\nmuch?

entries.jp: うーん　そうだなあ\nわしが人を信じるのは……
entries.en:
Hmm, lemme
think... The
reason I trust
folks is...

entries.jp: 何でだろう？
entries.en: Why is that?

entries.jp: 生まれつきだから
entries.en: I was born\nthis way

entries.jp: バカだから？
entries.en: 'Cause I'm\nan idiot?

entries.jp: 何でだろう？\n考えたこともないぜよ
entries.en: Why is that?\nNever even\nthought about it.

entries.jp: フン　そうか\n真面目に聞いた俺が\nバカだったようだな
entries.en:
Hmph. I see.
Seems I was the
idiot for asking
seriously.

entries.jp: そう言われても……\nわしは昔から\nずっとこんな感じだし
entries.en:
Even if you say
that... I've always
been like this,
since way back.

entries.jp: 人を信じるのに\n小難しい理由なんて\n必要ないぜよ
entries.en:
Ya don't
need some
fancy reason
to trust folks!

entries.jp: わしは物心ついた頃から\nずっとこんな感じじゃ
entries.en: I've been like\nthis ever since I\ncan remember.

entries.jp: 人を信じるのに\n小難しい理由なんて\n必要ないぜよ
entries.en:
Ya don't
need some
fancy reason
to trust folks!

entries.jp: ……バカだから？
entries.en: ...'Cause I'm\nan idiot?

entries.jp: 自分で認めるか\nバカじゃないのか\nこの天然が！
entries.en:
You admit it
yourself!? What
are you, stupid!?
You natural-born
airhead!

entries.jp: おお　そうか\nバカじゃなくて\nわしは天然なのかー
entries.en:
Oh, I get it! So I
ain't an idiot, I'm
a natural-born
airhead!

entries.jp: ……もういい\n聞いたオレ様が\nバカだった
entries.en: ...Forget it. Yours\ntruly was the\nidiot for asking.

entries.jp: それにシンディは\n赤の他人とは違う
entries.en: Besides, you ain't\nsome total\nstranger, Shindy.

entries.jp: 前にも言ったけど\nわしとシンディは同志\n同じ舞台に立つ仲間ぜよ
entries.en:
Like I said
before, Shindy,
you and me share
the same cause.
We're friends
standin' on the
same stage!

entries.jp: わしとシンディ\nそれにセンセー
entries.en: Me and you,\nShindy, and\nSensei too.

entries.jp: わしらは\n一人じゃなくて\n三人でロックをやってる
entries.en:
We ain't doin'
rock alone. The
three of us are
doin' it together.

entries.jp: だからどこまでも\n信じられる
entries.en: That's why I\ncan trust ya\nall the way.

entries.jp: 相変わらず生温い野郎だ\nオレ様には理解出来ない
entries.en:
Soft as ever, you.
That's beyond the
great Takasugi's
understanding.

entries.jp: 今はそうかもしれない\nだけど　シンディも\nきっとわかる日が来る
entries.en:
Maybe not now.
But someday
you'll get it
too, Shindy. I
just know it.

entries.jp: ちゅーわけで　明日は\nシンディの新曲で締める！\nわしは信じてる！
entries.en:
So that settles it!
Tomorrow we
close with your
new song, Shindy!
I believe in ya!

entries.jp: フン\n一生夢見てろ
entries.en: Hmph. Dream\non, forever.

entries.jp: 高杉は龍馬の言葉を鼻で笑い\n舞台の下見を続けた
entries.en:
Takasugi snorted
at Ryoma's words
and went on
scouting the
stage.

entries.jp: 次の日\nイケダヤンの観覧席は\n熱気で溢れかえっていた
entries.en:
The next day,
Ikedayan's seats
were overflowing
with excitement.

entries.jp: おぉ～～　シンディ\nセンセー　見てくれ\n見渡す限りの人人人ぜよ！
entries.en:
Whoaaa~ Shindy,
Sensei, look!
People, people,
people, far as
the eye can see!

entries.jp: これは圧巻ですね\n席が全部埋まってます
entries.en: What a sight.\nEvery last\nseat is filled.

entries.jp: 民衆はオレ様の歌を\n待ち侘びてるようだな\nフン　良い顔してやがる
entries.en:
Looks like the
people are dying
to hear the great
Takasugi's songs.
Hmph, look at
those faces.

entries.jp: 舞台袖から観客席を覗き\n龍馬達は短い言葉を交わす
entries.en:
Peeking at the
audience from
the wings, Ryoma
and the others
exchanged a few
words.

entries.jp: すぐそこに迫った雷舞本番に\n三人は晴れ晴れとした表情を\n浮かべていた
entries.en:
With the live
itself just
moments away,
the three wore
bright, clear
expressions.

entries.jp: この日のために\n積み重ねてきた音を\nやっとみんなに届けられる
entries.en:
The sound we've
been buildin' up
for this day... we
can finally bring
it to everybody!

entries.jp: シンディ　センセー\n準備はいいか？
entries.en: Shindy, Sensei,\nyou ready?

entries.jp: ああ\nいつだって完璧だ
entries.en: Yeah. I'm\nalways perfect,\nobviously.

entries.jp: 私も\n覚悟は出来ています
entries.en: I'm prepared\nas well.

entries.jp: 龍馬の問いかけに\n高杉と桂が頷く
entries.en:
At Ryoma's
question,
Takasugi and
Katsura nodded.

entries.jp: それを見計らったかのように\n観客が手を叩き始めた
entries.en: As if on cue,\nthe audience\nbegan to clap.

entries.jp: ふふ　観客が\n『早く出てくるように』と\n私達を急かし始めましたよ
entries.en:
Heh. The
audience has
started urging
us to "come
out already."

entries.jp: 上等じゃねーか\nやってやる
entries.en: Bring it on.\nLet's do this.

entries.jp: よぉぉぉし \nそれじゃあ\nいくぜよォ
entries.en: Alriiiight!\nHere we gooo!

entries.jp: 龍馬が拳を振り上げ\n舞台へ向かって走り出す
entries.en: Ryoma raised his\nfist and ran\ntoward the stage.

entries.jp: 高杉と桂も後に続き\n三人の姿が眩い光に\n照らし出される
entries.en:
Takasugi and
Katsura followed,
and the three
were bathed in
dazzling light.

entries.jp: うぉぉぉぉぉ\nみんなー\nよく来てくれたぜよーー！
entries.en:
Wooooah!
Everybody!
Thanks
for comin'!

entries.jp: わしらは　お前らを\n愛してるぜよーー
entries.en: We love y'all!

entries.jp: 今日はわしらの熱い愛を\nその耳その目で　その心で\n感じてくれーーーっ
entries.en:
Today, feel our
burnin' love
with your ears,
your eyes, and
your hearts!

entries.jp: 龍馬の叫びと\n観客の熱い声援が響く中\nついに雷舞が始まった
entries.en:
Amid Ryoma's
shout and the
crowd's fiery
cheers, the live
finally began.

entries.jp:
龍馬達のロックに
観客は酔いしれ
イケダヤンは
興奮のるつぼと化す
entries.en:
The audience was
enraptured by
Ryoma and the
others' rock, and
Ikedayan became
a melting pot of
excitement.

entries.jp:
そして
最高潮の盛り上がりの中
最後の一曲を
披露する時がやって来た
entries.en:
And at the peak
of the excitement,
the time came to
perform the final
song.

entries.jp: だがその瞬間\n招かれざる客が\n一斉に現れた
entries.en:
But at that very
moment,
uninvited
guests appeared
all at once.

entries.jp: 全員動くな！\n我らは新選組である！
entries.en: Nobody move!\nWe are the\nShinsengumi!

entries.jp: 上様の命を受け\nこれより雷舞の\n調査を行う！
entries.en:
By order of the
shogun, we will
now investigate
this live!

entries.jp: やはり\n坂本達だったか
entries.en: So it was\nSakamoto and\nhis lot after all.

entries.jp: 奴らがここで雷舞をする\nという噂は\n本当だったのだな
entries.en: So the rumor that\nthey'd hold a live\nhere was true.

entries.jp: 総司　出番だ\n手筈通りに頼んだぞ
entries.en: Soji, you're up.\nDo it as planned.

entries.jp: はい　了解でーす　\n任せてくださいね～
entries.en: Yes, roger thaaat.\nLeave it to me~

entries.jp: ざわめく観客を押し退けて\n近藤を先頭に新選組の隊士が\n舞台へと歩を進める
entries.en:
Pushing through
the murmuring
audience,
Shinsengumi
troopers led by
Kondo advanced
on the stage.

entries.jp: 龍馬達はその様子を見て\n咄嗟に身構えた
entries.en:
Seeing this,
Ryoma and the
others instantly
braced
themselves.

entries.jp: うぬ～\nここぞっちゅー時に\nまた新選組か！
entries.en:
Grr~ The
Shinsengumi
again, right
when it counts!

entries.jp: 警戒はしていたが\nやっぱり\n嗅ぎつけてきやがったか
entries.en:
I was on guard
for it, but they
sniffed us out
after all.

entries.jp: 今日はいつにも増して\n隊士の数が多いですね
entries.en: There are even\nmore troopers\nthan usual today.

entries.jp: このままだと\n彼らが舞台に辿り着くのは\n時間の問題だと思います
entries.en:
At this rate, I
believe it's only
a matter of time
before they
reach the stage.

entries.jp: おし　わかった\nだったら　わしが奴らの\n囮になって時間を稼ぐ
entries.en:
Okay, got it.
Then I'll be their
decoy and buy
us some time.

entries.jp: シンディとセンセーは\nその間に舞台で\n最後の一曲をやってくれ
entries.en:
Shindy, Sensei,
you two play
the last song
on stage while
I hold them off.

entries.jp: 雷舞が終わるまで\n今日は逃げん！
entries.en: Today I ain't\nrunnin' till\nthe live's over!

entries.jp: 新選組にも\nわしらのロックを\n聴かせてやる
entries.en: We'll make the\nShinsengumi\nhear our rock too!

entries.jp: それじゃ\n二人とも\n後は頼んだぜよ！
entries.en: Well then, I'm\ncountin' on you\ntwo for the rest!

entries.jp: シンディ\n新曲楽しみにしてる！
entries.en: Shindy, I'm\nlookin' forward to\nyour new song!

entries.jp: あっ\n龍馬くん！
entries.en: Ah-- Ryoma-kun!

entries.jp: 龍馬は笑顔で舞台を降りると\n二人に手を振って\n新選組の中に突っ込んでゆく
entries.en:
Ryoma hopped
off the stage
with a smile,
waved to the two,
and charged into
the Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: そんな龍馬を捕まえようと\n隊士達は躍起になって\n追いかけた
entries.en:
The troopers
chased after
Ryoma, desperate
to catch him.

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\n大丈夫でしょうか
entries.en: Will Ryoma-kun\nbe all right?

entries.jp: このままだと龍馬くんは\n隊士に取り押さえられそう\nだけども……
entries.en:
At this rate, it
looks like the
troopers will
pin Ryoma-kun
down, but...

entries.jp: 晋作　どうします？
entries.en: Shinsaku, what\nshall we do?

entries.jp: 龍馬くんの\n言う通りにしますか\nそれとも……
entries.en: Shall we do\nas Ryoma-kun\nsaid? Or...

entries.jp: ちッ……\nそんなの決まってるだろ
entries.en: Tch... You\nknow the\nanswer to that.

entries.jp:
高杉は己の迷いを
振り切るように
一歩前へ踏み出し
龍馬のもとへ走り出した
entries.en:
As if shaking off
his own
hesitation,
Takasugi stepped
forward and
broke into a run
toward Ryoma.

entries.jp: うぉぉぉ
entries.en: Raaaagh!

entries.jp: 高杉は叫びながら\n龍馬を追いかける敵を\n蹴散らしてゆく！
entries.en:
Shouting,
Takasugi sent the
enemies chasing
Ryoma flying!

entries.jp: ふっ\nそれでこそ晋作です\n私も加勢しますよ
entries.en:
Heh. That's
the Shinsaku I
know. I'll lend
a hand as well.

entries.jp:
高杉に続き
桂も発明品を使って
新選組を薙ぎ倒し
はじめた
entries.en:
Following
Takasugi,
Katsura began
mowing down the
Shinsengumi with
his inventions.

entries.jp: シンディ\nそれにセンセーも
entries.en: Shindy! And\nSensei too!

entries.jp: なんでじゃ？\nなんで舞台から降りた \n答えてくれ　シンディ！
entries.en:
Why? Why'd you
come off the
stage? Answer
me, Shindy!

entries.jp: 単なる気まぐれ
entries.en: Just a whim

entries.jp: 新選組と戦うため
entries.en: To fight the\nShinsengumi

entries.jp: 龍馬を助けるため
entries.en: To save Ryoma

entries.jp: 単なる気まぐれだ\n理由なんてねぇよ
entries.en: Just a whim.\nNo reason.

entries.jp: だったら\n今すぐ舞台へ戻るぜよ！\nシンディの新曲を歌え
entries.en:
Then get back on
that stage right
now! Sing your
new song, Shindy!

entries.jp: ……で　その後は\nバカを囮にして逃げろと？
entries.en:
...And after
that, I run off
and use the
idiot as a decoy?

entries.jp: このまま新選組を\n放っておけないだろ
entries.en: We can't just\nleave the\nShinsengumi be.

entries.jp: ああ　だから\nわしが奴らの相手をする
entries.en: Right, that's why\nI'm takin' 'em on.

entries.jp: シンディはセンセーと\n一緒に舞台へ戻るぜよ！
entries.en: You head back\nto the stage with\nSensei, Shindy!

entries.jp: 断る
entries.en: No.

entries.jp: 何でだ
entries.en: Why not!?

entries.jp: バカを助けに来てやった\n死ぬまで感謝しろよな
entries.en:
The great
Takasugi came
to save the idiot.
Be grateful till
the day you die.

entries.jp: 助けは無用っ\nシンディはセンセーと\n一緒に舞台へ戻るぜよ！
entries.en:
I don't need
savin'! You
head back to
the stage with
Sensei, Shindy!

entries.jp: 断る
entries.en: No.

entries.jp: 何でだ
entries.en: Why not!?

entries.jp: オレがお前の言う通り\n歌って逃げると思ったか？\nバカも休み休み言え
entries.en:
You thought
I'd do as you
said, sing, and
run? Spare me
the nonsense.

entries.jp: いいか　オレ達は\nロックをやってるんだ
entries.en: Listen. We\nplay rock.

entries.jp: 誰かを犠牲にして\n自分が助かるなんざ\nロックじゃねぇ
entries.en:
Sacrificing
somebody else
to save your
own skin?
That's not rock.

entries.jp: それに……\nオレ様の新曲には\nお前と桂さんの音が必要だ
entries.en:
Besides... my
masterpiece of a
new song needs
your sound and
Katsura-san's.

entries.jp: オレ様達は\n一人じゃなくて\n三人でロックをやってる
entries.en:
"The great
Takasugi AND
friends ain't doin'
rock alone. The
three of us are
doin' it together."

entries.jp: そう言ったのは\nお前だろう
entries.en: You're the one\nwho said that.

entries.jp: それに　バカを\n苛めていいのは\nオレ様だけだ
entries.en:
Besides, the
only one allowed
to pick on the
idiot is the great
Takasugi.

entries.jp: シンディ……
entries.en: Shindy...

entries.jp: 晋作は　いつになく\n熱い事を言いますね\n一体どうしたんです？
entries.en:
Shinsaku, you're
saying unusually
passionate things.
Whatever has
gotten into you?

entries.jp: シンディはもともと\n熱い男じゃ！\nロックな男だからなあ！
entries.en:
Shindy's always
been a passionate
guy! He's a rock 'n'
roll man, after all!

entries.jp: フン　オレ様は\nクールが売りだ
entries.en: Hmph. Cool is the\ngreat Takasugi's\ntrademark.

entries.jp: ははっ　晋作は\n素直じゃないですね
entries.en:
Haha. Shinsaku,
you never could
be honest with
yourself.

entries.jp: 龍馬達は互いを見つめ合い\n微笑を交わす
entries.en:
Ryoma and the
others looked at
one another and
exchanged smiles.

entries.jp: 三人の絆が一層強くなった\nその時……
entries.en:
Just as the
bond between
the three grew
stronger still...

entries.jp: 突然\n歌が流れ始めた
entries.en: ...a song suddenly\nbegan to play.

entries.jp: 龍馬達が舞台を見ると\nそこには眩い光を浴びて\n天歌を歌う沖田がいた
entries.en:
When Ryoma and
the others looked
to the stage,
there stood
Okita, bathed in
dazzling light,
singing Heaven's
Song.

entries.jp:
だが　その歌には奇妙な
ところがあった
端正な沖田の歌とも思えない
狂気じみた何かが潜んでいる
entries.en:
But the song was
strange.
Something like
madness lurked
in it, unthinkable
in Okita's
polished singing.

entries.jp: な　なんだ\nこの歌は
entries.en: Wh-what is\nthis song?

entries.jp: っ……何て\n禍々しい曲なんだ\n背中が寒くなってきたぜよ
entries.en:
Ngh... What an
ominous tune.
It's sendin' chills
down my spine.

entries.jp: 捕り物騒動で\n騒いでいた観客達が\n突然静かになりました
entries.en:
The audience,
in an uproar
over the arrests,
has suddenly
gone quiet.

entries.jp: みんなの無表情で\n無気力なこの感じは……
entries.en: Everyone's blank,\nlistless look...\nThis feeling...

entries.jp: これが天歌の\n泰平化ですか……
entries.en: So this is\nHeaven's Song's\npacification...

entries.jp: だがこんな急激な\n泰平化は初めて見たぞ
entries.en: But I've never\nseen pacification\nthis sudden.

entries.jp: ソウちんの様子が\nいつもと違う……\n……大丈夫なのか？
entries.en: So-chin ain't actin'\nlike himself... Is\nhe all right?

entries.jp: 龍馬は沖田を\n心配そうに見上げて\n舞台に駆けあがろうとする
entries.en:
Ryoma looked
up at Okita
with worry and
tried to rush up
onto the stage.

entries.jp: だが彼の行く手に\n近藤と土方が\n立ちはだかった
entries.en: But Kondo and\nHijikata blocked\nhis way.

entries.jp: 坂本　止まれ
entries.en: Sakamoto. Stop.

entries.jp: 総司には近づくな\n俺達が相手をしてやる
entries.en: Stay away\nfrom Soji. We'll\ndeal with you.

entries.jp: 今は争ってる場合じゃない\n舞台を見てみろ\nソウちんの様子が変だ
entries.en:
This ain't the
time for fightin'!
Look at the stage!
Somethin's wrong
with So-chin!

entries.jp: 何？\n総司の様子が？
entries.en: What?\nSomething's\nwrong with Soji?

entries.jp: そうだ\n今すぐ　ソウちんの歌を\n止めさせるぜよ
entries.en:
That's right! We
gotta make
So-chin stop
singin', right now!

entries.jp: 龍馬の訴えを聞き\n近藤は彼と対峙したまま\n視線を舞台に逸らそうとする
entries.en:
Hearing Ryoma's
plea, Kondo, still
facing him, began
to turn his eyes
toward the stage.

entries.jp: しかしその動きに\n土方が待ったをかけた
entries.en: But Hijikata\nstopped him.

entries.jp: 近藤さん　敵の口車に\n乗ってはいけませんよ
entries.en:
Kondo-san,
don't fall for
the enemy's
smooth talk.

entries.jp: こいつらは\n俺達の気を逸らすつもりだ
entries.en: They mean to\ndistract us.

entries.jp: ここで俺達の役目を\n果たしましょう
entries.en: Let's carry out\nour duty here.

entries.jp: む……　そうだな\nすまない\n油断してしまった
entries.en: Mm... You're\nright. Sorry. I let\nmy guard down.

entries.jp: 坂本　覚悟しろ
entries.en: Sakamoto,\nprepare yourself!

entries.jp: そ　そんな～～\nわしの話をちゃんと\n聞くぜよ～～っ
entries.en: N-no waaay~!\nListen to what\nI'm sayin'~!

entries.jp: 断る
entries.en: No.

entries.jp: 近藤と土方\nそして大勢の隊士が\n龍馬ににじり寄る
entries.en:
Kondo, Hijikata,
and a crowd of
troopers inched
in on Ryoma.

entries.jp: その隙を突いて\n高杉が舞台へと駆け出した
entries.en:
Seizing the
opening,
Takasugi dashed
for the stage.

entries.jp: シンディ
entries.en: Shindy!

entries.jp: オレ様の晴れ舞台に\n薄気味悪い曲を垂れ\n流しやがって　気に入らねェ
entries.en:
Spewing creepy
music all over
yours truly's big
night... I don't
like it one bit.

entries.jp: 龍馬　桂さん\n二人は新選組と遊びながら\n伴奏の準備でもしてろ
entries.en:
Ryoma,
Katsura-san. You
two play with
the Shinsengumi
and get ready to
back me up.

entries.jp: オレ様が舞台に戻って\n奴の歌を止めてやる \n今すぐにな
entries.en:
I'm getting back
on that stage and
shutting his song
down. Right now.

entries.jp: シンディ\nわかった！
entries.en: Shindy... Got it!

entries.jp: 頼みましたよ\n晋作
entries.en: We're counting\non you, Shinsaku.

entries.jp: ああ　オレ様に任せろ\nこれからとっておきの\n新曲を聴かせてやる
entries.en:
Yeah, leave it to
the great
Takasugi. Time
to let you hear
my ace new song.

entries.jp: ……んー？\n下から雑音が聞こえるなぁ
entries.en: ...Hmm? I hear\nnoise coming\nfrom down there.

entries.jp: 雷舞の間は　静かに\n歌に耳を傾けましょうって\n大人に教わらなかったの？
entries.en:
Didn't the
grown-ups
teach you to
listen quietly
to the songs
during a live?

entries.jp: お口にチャックだよ\nそこのスカシくん
entries.en: Zip those lips,\nMr. Poser.

entries.jp: うるせぇ\n黙るのはてめーの方だ！
entries.en: Shut up! You're\nthe one who's\ngonna be quiet!

entries.jp: そこはオレ様の陣地だ\n今すぐに降りろ
entries.en: That's my turf.\nGet down from\nthere right now.

entries.jp: あーあー　うるさーい\nせっかく注意してあげたのに\n口答えするんだ　ふーん
entries.en:
Ugh, so noisy. I
was nice
enough to warn
you, and you
talk back? Hmm.

entries.jp: 悪い子には\nお仕置きが必要だね
entries.en: Bad kids need\nto be punished,\ndon't they?

entries.jp: 君を僕の歌でねじ伏せて
entries.en: I'll crush you\nwith my song...

entries.jp: 二度と騒げないように\n君の唇を縫いつけて\nあげるよ
entries.en:
...and sew your
lips shut so you
can never make
a fuss again.

entries.jp: フン　やれるモンなら\nやってみろ
entries.en: Hmph. Try\nit if you can.

entries.jp: わーい　本当？\n嬉しいなあ
entries.en: Yay, really?\nHow nice!

entries.jp: ……だったら　僕\n本気出しちゃうね？
entries.en: ...Then I guess I'll\nget serious, okay?

entries.jp: 狂気を孕んだ沖田の歌が\n雷舞屋に更に響き渡る！
entries.en:
Okita's song,
pregnant with
madness, rang
out even
louder through
the live house!

entries.jp: お前ごときに……\n天歌にオレ様のロックが\n負けるかよ！
entries.en:
To the likes of
you... As if the
great Takasugi's
rock would lose
to Heaven's Song!

entries.jp:
ヤバイ 来たぜ来たぜ
来たぜ……
オレの中でなんかが
雷光（スパーク）した
entries.en:
Oh, man. Here it
comes, here it
comes, here it
comes... Somethin'
inside me just
SPARKED!

entries.jp:
来い来い来い もっと
エンジョイしろよ
テメェ等
クールに行くぜ！
entries.en:
Come on, come
on, come on!
Enjoy it more,
people! We're
goin' cool!

entries.jp: 黒か白か\n伸るか反るか\n最後まで付き合え
entries.en:
Black or white,
all or nothing!
Stick with me
to the very end!
